title: Build
description: A build: the files a page loads, each a build_file blob served at /<path>, and the modules the server hosts, retained beside them. Files are in path order and modules in role order, so one tree is one document and one hash. A UI's bundle is a build with no server modules. The Go host owns this kind: the schema is written by hand, and server/schema_test.go checks it against the Go type and against a build the server commits (docs/FORMATS.md, "Builds"). A field whose format is content-hash names a blob in the store (docs/FORMATS.md, "The store describes itself").

files.description: The build's files, in path order.

server.description: The modules the server hosts, in role order. Absent in a UI's bundle.

path.description: The file's path under the web root, with no leading slash.

hash.description: The build_file blob that holds the file's exact bytes.

type.description: The content type the file is served with.
